description: Experience a unique cooking show packed with chef-inspired dishes, medicinal recipes, village-style cooking, and celebrity guests, all woven into exciting and unique weekly themes — with opportunities for viewers to participate too.

Things take a momentous shift when a bold & loving village girl, Malli, crosses paths with a doting father and his 6-year-old daughter who yearns for a mother's love. Join the family's journey through the nuances of love, affection & parenthood. Malli – early access only on Sun NXT.

Poongodi rises above her father's male chauvinism, intent on proving herself & pursuing a college education. Her path crosses with Saravanan, a naïve young man who blindly trusts his manipulative stepmother. Uncover the fate of the two kindred souls.

A powerful tale of two sisters, Thulasi and Thendral, whose bond is tested by betrayal, greed, and dark intentions. United by courage and love, they rise strong to expose the truth in their battle against injustice.
